entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The night sky of Theros and the home of the Gods, a realm tied to dreams and the subconscious.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane whose night sky is Nyx.

entities.name: Nyxborn
entities.description: Creatures born in Nyx, living enchantments formed from collective subconscious and the gods' will.

entities.name: Mount Hiastos
entities.description: A drifting mountain in Nyx crowned by a golden orb, home of several gods.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who rules from a gold and white marble palace on Mount Hiastos.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God who forges beneath Mount Hiastos.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God who resides near the summit of Mount Hiastos, unleashing lightning bolts of inspiration.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God who visits a sanctuary in an ancient forest on Mount Hiastos.

entities.name: Mystic Sea
entities.description: A realm of mist and water in Nyx concealing mysteries.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God whose palace rests beneath the waves of the Mystic Sea.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: God who resides in a city of divine copper and marbleized dreams at the Mystic Sea's edge.

entities.name: Nykthos
entities.description: A shrine to the gods that has an astral version in Nyx.

entities.name: Tovian Fields
entities.description: A vast expanse of raw energies in Nyx where Nyxborn legends wage an eternal war.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God who commands the conflict in the Tovian Fields from a war-tent.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God who commands the conflict in the Tovian Fields from a war-tent.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God who claims the borders of the Tovian Fields and contains the battle.

events.summary: Kruphix exerts a binding influence on the borders of the Tovian Fields, preventing the eternal war led by Mogis and Iroas from spreading across Nyx.
events.quote: Kruphix claims the borders of the Tovian Fields as his domain

relations.quote: Heliod rules from a vast palace of gold and white marble
a drifting mountain that stands out sharply against the star-filled sky of Nyx
the grand war-tents of Mogis and Iroas
